auth.signInSubtitle: Private AI assistants grounded in your verified documents.
auth.tagline: Enterprise-grade RAG with real citations and zero hallucination tolerance.

hero.titleBefore: Every answer points to the page
hero.lead: SourceMind creates private assistants to query your manuals, policies, and contracts. If documents don't have the information, the assistant says so.

how.title: From file to answer in four steps.
how.step1Desc: Give it a name and connect your OpenRouter key. Each assistant has its own base and history.
how.step2Desc: Add PDF, DOCX, or TXT files with clean extraction and vector indexing.
how.step3Desc: Write in natural language. Search combines semantics and exact keywords.
how.step4Desc: Answers come with document, page, and original snippet in a dedicated accordion.

mock.question: How many vacation days do I have?
mock.answer: Full-time employees receive 30 paid vacation days per year.
mock.item1: Full-time employees are entitled to 30 paid vacation days per calendar year.
mock.item2: Unused vacation days may be carried over until March 31 of the following year with manager approval.
mock.disclaimer: Real SourceMind interface screens. The floating answer is an illustrative mockup with sample data.

problem.title: Today, answers are scattered across files.
problem.lead1: The main rule is in a PDF, the exception in another document, and the latest update in someone's inbox. Searching file by file wastes time, and generic AI forces you to trust answers no one can verify.
problem.lead2: With SourceMind, each assistant only reads what you upload and answers strictly from those files, citing the exact source.
problem.query: How many vacation days do I have?
problem.doc1Text: Full-time employees are entitled to 30 paid vacation days per calendar year.
problem.doc2Text: Unused vacation days may be carried over until March 31 of the following year with manager approval.
problem.doc3Text: Remote work is permitted up to three days per week at manager discretion.
problem.doc4Text: Invoice payment must be completed within 30 days of receipt.
problem.doc4Note: Mentions “30 days” as well, but about a different topic.
problem.ans1: Full-time employees receive 30 paid vacation days per year.
problem.ans2: Unused days may be carried over until March 31 with manager approval.
problem.step1: 1. You ask a question in natural language.
problem.step2: 2. The assistant reads your files and extracts only matching snippets. Unrelated files stay out.
problem.step3: 3. The answer is returned with direct citations for you to verify.

confidence.title: Engineered to say “I don't know”.
confidence.subtitle: An answer is only reliable if you can verify it. Without a supporting snippet, the assistant honestly abstains instead of inventing data.
confidence.abstQuery: What is the parental leave policy for contractors?
confidence.abstText: I could not find sufficient evidence in the indexed documents to answer this question. Please upload the relevant policy or rephrase your question.
confidence.abstNote: Strict relevance threshold: if retrieval does not find sufficient similarity, the assistant rejects speculation.
confidence.card1Text: Every claim points directly to the document and original excerpt in a minimalist accordion.
confidence.card1Snippet: Full-time employees are entitled to 30 paid vacation days per calendar year.
confidence.card2Text: Seamless combination of vector semantic search and keyword lexical matching.

control.title: You control what the assistant knows.
control.card1Text: Each assistant has its own dedicated knowledge base and independent chat history.
control.card2Text: Upload new manuals or remove obsolete documents with one-click safe deletion.
control.card3Text: Your OpenRouter key is encrypted with AES-256 on the server and never exposed to the browser.
control.card4Text: Interface in Portuguese, English, and Spanish with instant light and dark mode switching.
